requirements.statement: live_ledger_custody looks run holds up by the full primary key (project_id, kind, identity), with kind limited to the kinds whose identity is a launch handle digest (run_slot, binding); the same rows count as live custody.
A plan test pins EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN of every query in live_ledger_custody to the full-key search of run_holds (no SCAN).
On small ledgers built by the S14c script through the runner (16 and 128 MiB) the custody query time grows about linearly (a ratio bound, not absolute seconds).
